note: Generated from the reference walk of algorithm.md. Both clients must reproduce every expected block exactly; compare as JSON with arrays in order and object keys unordered.

cases.name: empty history
cases.note: No plays: no cells, everything locked, rates over an owned Core Set.

cases.name: one loss is played, not won
cases.note: A lost game gives a played cell and no completion.

cases.name: one win
cases.note: A won cell: best won, the level kept, first win dated; completion 1 of 6 owned cells.

cases.name: loss then win on the same cell
cases.note: Two attempts, one win; the cell renders at its best result.

cases.name: unordered input is sorted by playedAt then id
cases.note: Facts arrive out of order; firstWonAt and the unlock follow the sorted order.

cases.name: same instant, ties by id
cases.note: Two wins at the same playedAt: the unlock of the first-win tier is the lower id.

cases.name: expert win outranks standard in a cell
cases.note: bestLevelWon is the highest level among wins, whatever the order.

cases.name: unknown level counts as won but not as expert
cases.note: A v1 play with no difficulty satisfies no minDifficulty.

cases.name: box coverage unlocks on the last scenario
cases.note: Three Core wins in any order; the unlock is the latest of the meeting facts.

cases.name: box coverage on expert needs expert wins everywhere
cases.note: One standard win among the three leaves the expert version at 2 of 3.

cases.name: unowned box is unavailable, progress still counted
cases.note: Core is not owned: the Core coverage is unavailable while its progress shows.

cases.name: an unlocked achievement stays unlocked when the box leaves the collection
cases.note: Done beats unavailable.

cases.name: global coverage over every scenario
cases.note: One scenario short of the whole catalogue: 4 of 5, locked, never unavailable.

cases.name: heroes won counts the owner seat only
cases.note: A win with a second seat does not credit that seat for hero coverage.

cases.name: any-seat tally credits every hero at the table
cases.note: The second seat gets a cell with an anySeat win and an empty owner tally.

cases.name: all four aspects, a two-aspect seat counts for both
cases.note: Spider-Woman-style seats meet two aspects at once; pool never counts.

cases.name: all four aspects against one scenario
cases.note: Only wins against rhino count; a klaw win with the missing aspect does not.

cases.name: tiers: bronze, then silver, unlock at gold
cases.note: Six plays reach gold at the sixth; the tier is the highest threshold met.

cases.name: tiers below the first threshold
cases.note: One play: no tier, progress 1 of the top threshold.

cases.name: heroes played counts distinct owner heroes
cases.note: Three heroes over four plays: silver, one short of gold.

cases.name: distinct days are UTC days
cases.note: Plays on either side of a UTC midnight are two days; the same day twice is one.

cases.name: true solo needs exactly one player
cases.note: A two-player win does not unlock the solo achievement; a solo loss does not either.

cases.name: four players with four different aspects
cases.note: Distinct aspect sets across all seats; a repeated aspect fails the strict one.

cases.name: a seat with no aspect never has distinct aspects
cases.note: Empty aspect sets fail the distinct-aspects rule.

cases.name: a finished campaign unlocks at its last play
cases.note: The unlock is the latest play of the first qualifying run; a defeat inside disqualifies the clean one.

cases.name: a lost campaign does not count
cases.note: finished but lost: no campaign achievement.

cases.name: a clean expert campaign
cases.note: No defeat and expert level: all three campaign achievements, dated at the last play.

cases.name: a finished run with no plays unlocks without a date
cases.note: Done is true, unlockedAt null, and it is absent from recent.

cases.name: draft mode win
cases.note: A win carrying mode draft unlocks the mode achievement; a loss does not.

cases.name: a scenario the catalogue does not know
cases.note: An unresolved campaign key keeps its cell and counts for volume, never for completion.

cases.name: recent is newest first, ties by id
cases.note: Three unlocks, two at the same instant.
